notes: Adds missing schema/contract and expiration enforcement coverage for token lifecycle completeness.

change_log.note: Add schema layer for lifecycle fields

GPTR-F-002-S75.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
GPTR-F-002-S75.description: Define and implement token data model including fields for token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, rotated_from, revoked_at, and actor_scope. Ensure compatibility with MongoDB storage and existing auth validation paths.
GPTR-F-002-S75.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No structured lifecycle schema currently defined

GPTR-F-002-S76.title: Token Expiration Enforcement Middleware
GPTR-F-002-S76.description: Implement expiration validation in bearer token authentication flow. Reject tokens past expires_at and ensure consistent enforcement across GPTReader and Azure Function endpoints.
GPTR-F-002-S76.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: Expiration not consistently enforced

GPTR-F-002-S77.title: Token Rotation Chain Validation
GPTR-F-002-S77.description: Implement validation logic ensuring only the most recently rotated token in a chain is valid. Enforce rotated_from lineage and invalidate all ancestor tokens upon rotation.
GPTR-F-002-S77.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No rotation lineage tracking exists
